# Chapter register {#sec-chapter-register}

The register lists every chapter with its guiding question, intended readers, prerequisites, learning activity,
course workshop and primary source. It is also available as a machine-readable file:
[`editorial/chapter-register.csv`](https://github.com/r-heller/clinical-data-science-in-r/blob/main/editorial/chapter-register.csv).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-chapter-register
#| tbl-cap: "Chapters B01–B28 with guiding question, course workshop and lab."
#| echo: false
register <- utils::read.csv2("../editorial/chapter-register.csv", check.names = FALSE,
                             encoding = "UTF-8", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
spalten <- intersect(c("B-ID", "Part", "Title", "Guiding question", "W-ID", "Path status", "R lab"),
                     names(register))
knitr::kable(register[, spalten], row.names = FALSE)
```
